Wellness

Rituals to restore your balance after travelling.

Wellness

Facial Hydration

The journey also shows on the skin. This facial ritual from Pasitea Spa is designed to revive, nourish and restore its natural balance, combating dryness and fatigue from the very first session — forty minutes that you'll notice immediately.

Rest

Relaxing Massage

After a long flight or a full day exploring the city, your body craves a break. Our relaxing massage stimulates circulation, releases accumulated muscle tension, and restores balance between body and mind—available in 1-hour or 1.5-hour sessions, in partnership with Pasitea Spa.

View full portfolio

Ultra Vit

Serum Therapy

After a long flight, your body notices it before your mind. Our Ultra Vit IV therapy replenishes hydration, reduces inflammation, and provides a real energy boost—designed for jet lag, travel fatigue, and those days when your body craves an active break, not just rest.
